C0271.title: Fenyang Tianlang E-Commerce Co., Ltd. Fined for Online Product Descriptions Not Matching Actual Goods
C0271.summary: In February 2020, the Fenyang Market Supervision Administration penalized Fenyang Tianlang E-Commerce Co., Ltd. for selling products online with descriptions that did not match the actual goods, violating Article 20 of the Consumer Rights Protection Law. The company had its illegal gains of 200 yuan confiscated and was fined 1,800 yuan.
